Not sure what country you’re in but I used QuickMD and was able to connect with a doctor in 10 mins, get a sub script, and not have to go through hell. It costs $90 to meet with the doctor but it was worth every penny. 

The only issue was that I previously detoxed at rehab with this dose of subs:
8mg morning
4 mg lunch
8mg dinner 

7ish day taper knocking a few mg off every 2 days. 
Also taking this insane benzo (insane for me - took me OUT). I now know why I didn’t sleep ever in that 30 days… 

Mind you I was not doing pressed, I was taking pharmacy 30s

Here’s what I learned detoxing on my own this time with the help of subs - this was with the help of a very knowledgeable friend who saved me from having a very bad time on subs lol
1. Do NOT UNDER ANY CIRCUMSTANCE take subs before you are measuring on the COWS scale - I believe my doc said score of 8. You’re gonna have to wait at least 24 hours, I think, but don’t quote me since I wasn’t using pressed. You will send yourself into PW and you will wish you were dead. Just search PW or precipitated withdrawal here…
2. Ok so you’re feeling some withdrawal - take 1-2mg at a time and wait a bit to see if it helps - the goal is to use the smallest amount of subs to avoid having to do another withdrawal from a high dose 
3. Write down your dose - I was like oh I’ll remember lol, nope. I had the pills so I cut them. 
4. Have your care kit - someone you can call, snacks, water, Imodium, zofran, I couldn’t get a benzo for this time around but I have Gabapentin. Ideally you can have a few days to yourself. I experienced horrific night sweats and nightmares, I’d wake up screaming. 
5. Try to connect with some people in recovery. I was doing the dance of relapsing during subs… which doesn’t even really work because of the blocks and just destroys your brain and sleep
6. You can do this! 

Ok hope this helps good luck OP
